forecasts.question: Will Iran resume negotiations with the US before EOD 2026-06-16?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-YES. MOU digitally signed June 14 by named principals (Witkoff/Kushner for US, Araghchi/Ghalibaf for Iran) with Pakistan as named mediator — before EOD June 16 deadline. Islamabad meetings April 11-12 constituted the highest US-Iran diplomatic contact since 1979; June 14 signing within horizon window satisfies the held-session criterion on preponderance of evidence confirmed by AP, Reuters, NPR, Al Jazeera, ABC News, NBC News.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-06-16, a publicly confirmed HELD negotiating session (direct or mediated via Oman/Qatar/Pakistan) occurs between named US and Iranian principals/envoys, OR an official Iranian statement (MFA/state media IRNA/Tasnim/Fars) rescinds the 2026-06-01 suspension. A held mediated session counts; mere rhetorical assertion that 'talks continue' or relay of written messages does NOT count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + official Iranian state-media; State Dept or Iran MFA statement also resolves.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Trump-only assertions without Iranian/mediator confirmation do NOT count; written-message exchanges that are not a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; one side asserting talks 'continue' without a named convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: Islamabad meeting April 11-12 confirmed by AP, Reuters, NPR — named US/Iran principals
MOU digital signature June 14 with named Pakistan mediator (Al Jazeera, ABC News, NBC News)

forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Reuters/AP/AFP/Axios/Al Jazeera/Times of Israel; State Dept or Iran MFA statement also qualifies.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Mere relay of written messages, or one side asserting talks 'continue' without a named convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: CNN live coverage of Bürgenstock session June 21 — named principals confirmed
Al Jazeera Bürgenstock outcomes article June 22 — roadmap and working groups confirmed

forecasts.question: Will a publicly confirmed direct Israel-Iran military exchange (strikes both ways) occur in any 48h window before EOD 2026-06-24?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-YES. June 7-8, 2026: Iran fired ballistic missiles at Israel following IDF strikes against southern Beirut; Israel retaliated with counter-strikes — first direct bidirectional exchange since the April ceasefire. Time magazine, Al Jazeera, and multiple TIER1 outlets confirmed the exchange as mutually confirmed and two-directional within a 48h window, satisfying the criterion 16 days before EOD June 24.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a publicly confirmed direct Israel-Iran military exchange — Israeli strikes on Iranian targets AND Iranian strikes on Israeli/Israeli-claimed targets — within any rolling 48h window between 2026-06-10 and 2026-06-24.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/CNN/Al Jazeera) OR one TIER1 + official Israeli (IDF) or Iranian (IRGC) statement.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Proxy-only attacks (Hezbollah/Houthi) without direct Iran-Israel state strikes do NOT count; one-directional strikes within the 48h window = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: TIER1 confirmation of June 7-8 bidirectional exchange — Time magazine, Al Jazeera, CNN
IDF + IRGC reciprocal strike statements within 48h window confirmed

forecasts.question: Will Hormuz reach >=50 commercial transits/day (7-day avg) before EOD 2026-07-02?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO. Commercial transit through Hormuz never reached 50/day on a 7-day rolling average during the window. Peak was approximately 42 commercial vessels on a single day (June 23, per BNN Bloomberg maritime tracker); the 5-day average in late June was 21-27 vessels/day against a pre-war baseline of 125-140. By July 2, traffic was again declining as IRGC activity increased; Iran attacked three vessels July 6-7, ending the brief partial opening. The threshold was structurally unachievable given ongoing mining and IRGC pressure.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if IMF PortWatch (or equivalent AIS) records >=50 commercial transits/day averaged over any consecutive 7-day window between 2026-06-02 and 2026-07-02.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: IMF PortWatch + one TIER1/OSINT shipping report (Bloomberg/Reuters/Lloyd's List).
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Naval-escorted convoys count; one-off surge days below a 7-day window do NOT qualify; if PortWatch unpublished, use best AIS tracker and flag AMBIGUOUS if sources conflict >20%.

indicators.name: BNN Bloomberg: peak single-day ~42 vessels June 23 — below 50/day threshold
indicators.expected_effect: +20pp toward YES if rising trend observed

indicators.name: P&I war-risk cover reinstated for Hormuz transit

forecasts.question: Will mine-countermeasure clearing operations actively commence in Hormuz before EOD 2026-07-10?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-AMBIGUOUS (human review required). CENTCOM formally commenced mine-countermeasure operations April 11, 2026 (USS Frank E. Peterson Jr. DDG-121 and USS Michael Murphy DDG-112), confirmed by CENTCOM press release, NavalNews, and DefenseScoop — 60 days BEFORE the forecast window opened (June 10). A second phase commenced June 16 after MOU signing, with UK/French contributions finalized June 4. Analyst resolves YES (operations 'actively ongoing' within window); DA flags temporal mismatch in resolution criteria (window requires commencement 'between 2026-06-10 and 2026-07-10' but the original commencement event predates the window). Judge resolves AMBIGUOUS: if the June 16 UK/French contribution phase constitutes a distinct post-creation commencement event, ruling converts to YES. Human author must confirm.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports mine-countermeasure vessels/operations have actively commenced clearing the Strait of Hormuz (US/coalition/third-party) between 2026-06-10 and 2026-07-10.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Reuters/AP/AFP/Bloomberg/CNBC, or a named US/UK/coalition naval/Pentagon statement carried by TIER1.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Stated intent, vessel positioning, or planning without confirmed commencement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Operations that commenced before the forecast window and were ongoing within it = AMBIGUOUS pending criteria clarification.

Al Arabiya: UK/France finalized Hormuz demining contributions June 4; new phase June 16

forecasts.question: Will the Knesset pass the dissolution bill's final reading with a fixed election date earlier than 2026-10-27 before EOD 2026-07-15?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO. Both prongs failed. (1) Timeline: Knesset voted for dissolution July 17 — two days AFTER EOD July 15. (2) Election date: fixed at October 27, 2026 — NOT earlier than October 27. Israel Hayom (July 12), JNS (July 17), and Al Jazeera (July 17) confirm. The coalition completed its full mandate term for only the second time since 1988; the EOD July 15 criterion was not met on either dimension.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if the Knesset passes the dissolution bill in final (third) reading AND that passage specifies a fixed election date earlier than 2026-10-27, before EOD 2026-07-15.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two TIER1 (Times of Israel/Reuters/AP/JPost) citing the Knesset plenum vote record.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Preliminary/first/second readings without final passage do NOT count; passage that leaves the date to a later committee or sets only a band without a fixed date = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; if a fixed date on/after 27 Oct is set, resolve NO.

indicators.name: Knesset third-reading dissolution vote July 17 — AFTER EOD July 15 deadline
Election date confirmed October 27 — not earlier than October 27 (JNS, Times of Israel)
indicators.expected_effect: +15pp toward YES if date earlier than October 27

forecasts.question: Will Netanyahu's coalition lose its Knesset majority or dissolve early before 2026-10-27?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-YES via ambiguity_rule (criteria/ambiguity_rule conflict resolved in favor of ambiguity_rule). Coalition fell to 48 mandates when Degel HaTorah and Agudat Yisrael withdrew support over draft-law non-compliance. Rabbi Dov Lando declared Netanyahu a liar and gave clearance for dissolution. Knesset voted formally for dissolution July 17, 2026 — 102 days before horizon. ambiguity_rule explicitly states: 'If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES.' Both prongs satisfied. Note: resolution_criteria's 'roll-call vote' language did not match the actual mechanism (party withdrawal), but the ambiguity_rule governs edge cases and is determinative here. Judge drafted an improved criteria note for F7's successor on the next board.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a Knesset roll-call vote confirms coalition loss of majority (61 seats), OR if Netanyahu announces early dissolution and election date moves earlier than 2026-10-27. NO if coalition survives to mandatory election date with 61+ seats intact.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Knesset official record + Reuters/Haaretz/Times of Israel. Polling alone does not resolve.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES. If a single party departs but coalition retains 61+: NO. Roll-call vote is illustrative not exhaustive — numerical coalition collapse by any mechanism qualifies per ambiguity_rule.

indicators.name: Degel HaTorah + Agudat Yisrael withdrawal — coalition fell to 48 mandates
Knesset dissolution vote July 17, 2026 (JNS, Al Jazeera, Times of Israel)

forecasts.question: Will the US military carry out confirmed airstrikes on Iranian power-generation or oil-refining facilities before EOD 2026-07-25?
forecasts.delta_reason: Enters board Day 145. CENTCOM has conducted 11 consecutive nights of strikes against military and logistical targets in Isfahan, Chabahar, Konarak, and Bandar Abbas (July 21 communiqué). Trump's public statement 'We'll hit nuclear site' raises probability of crossing into civilian-adjacent infrastructure. CENTCOM communiqués through July 21 name military facilities only; energy targeting would represent a significant escalation threshold. p=0.35 reflects elevated but sub-majority probability within 72-hour horizon.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: CENTCOM or Pentagon official press release confirms at least one US strike hit a power plant, electrical substation, or oil refinery within Iranian territory before EOD 2026-07-25 (23:59 ET). Strikes on military facilities co-located with energy infrastructure count only if CENTCOM names energy infrastructure as a named target.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Reuters, AP, AFP, Bloomberg, or CENTCOM.mil official press release. IRNA/Tasnim alone insufficient.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Strikes on oil ports (Bandar Abbas docks) count only if refinery or storage tank infrastructure is explicitly confirmed damaged. Iranian state media claims of power outages without CENTCOM confirmation do not count. If CENTCOM press release is delayed past EOD July 25, most recent confirmed target list available by EOD is used.

indicators.name: Trump public statements specifically naming power stations or nuclear sites as targets
CENTCOM daily strike communiqués — watch for 'power' or 'electrical' in target descriptions
Satellite imagery via Maxar or Planet showing thermal anomalies near Iranian power facilities
Tasnim/IRNA reporting on blackouts in specific Iranian provinces

Qatar and Pakistan maintain active mediation contacts but without operational substance. The 8-day horizon is aggressive against current kinetic tempo.

forecasts.question: Will Houthi forces carry out a confirmed kinetic attack on Saudi oil export infrastructure or a Saudi-bound oil tanker before EOD 2026-08-05?
forecasts.delta_reason: Enters board Day 145. Houthis declared a maritime blockade against Saudi Arabia July 20, citing Saudi blockade of Yemen and attack on Sanaa airport. Bab el-Mandeb, carrying 12% of global trade, is now under a declared blockade alongside the effectively closed Hormuz. Declared intent, historical Houthi execution rate on maritime threats (Abqaiq 2019, Jizan 2020), and active 14-day horizon support p=0.55. Mitigating factor: Saudi and US interceptor capacity.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: Saudi Aramco, Saudi government (SPA), or Saudi Ministry of Defense confirms damage to a Saudi oil export terminal, pipeline, or storage facility; OR a tanker confirmed bound for or departing a Saudi Red Sea port is struck by Houthi weapons before EOD 2026-08-05. Attempted attacks that are fully intercepted do not count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Saudi Press Agency (SPA), Saudi Aramco official communications, Reuters, AP, or Bloomberg. Houthi spokesman Al-Bukhaiti claim alone insufficient.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Attacks on non-oil Saudi infrastructure (airports, military bases, power) do not count. Attacks on third-party tankers transiting Bab el-Mandeb not destined for Saudi ports do not count. If Aramco confirms damage but does not name Houthis within 72 hours, resolve AMBIGUOUS pending attribution.

indicators.name: Houthi spokesman Mohammed Al-Bukhaiti Telegram/X announcement of attack on Saudi oil target
Ship-tracking (MarineTraffic/Windward) showing tanker avoidance of Yanbu or Ras Tanura
Lloyd's Marine Intelligence Unit insurance alerts for Red Sea / Bab el-Mandeb
Saudi defense ministry air-defense activation notice or Aramco export volume statement

forecasts.question: Will commercial vessel transits through the Strait of Hormuz reach a 7-day rolling average of 15 or more per day before EOD 2026-08-05?
forecasts.delta_reason: Enters board Day 145. NBC News tracker July 19-20: 9 outbound + 5 inbound = 14 vessels/24h — at threshold on a single day, but the resolution criteria require a 7-day rolling average >= 15. For the window to close before August 5, a 7-day average would need to be sustained from approximately July 29 onward. Against 11 consecutive nights of US strikes and no ceasefire in sight, sustained above-threshold transit is highly improbable. p=0.10 confirmed.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: Any established maritime tracking service (Windward, MarineTraffic, Lloyd's List Intelligence, UKMTO, or NBC News data graphics tracker) confirms a 7-day rolling average of >= 15 commercial vessel transits per day through the Strait of Hormuz, with the full 7-day measurement window ending before EOD 2026-08-05.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Windward, MarineTraffic transit logs, UKMTO shipping notices, Lloyd's List Intelligence, NBC News data graphics Hormuz tracker.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Military or naval vessels do not count toward the commercial count. A single spike day with surrounding near-zero days does not satisfy the 7-day rolling average requirement. If no maritime tracker publishes calibrated daily data for this specific window, resolve AMBIGUOUS.

indicators.name: NBC News Hormuz tracker: 7-day rolling average >= 15 commercial transits/day
IRGC official statement lifting strait blockade or ceasefire taking effect
CENTCOM escort-mission announcement for commercial convoy corridor through Hormuz
Brent crude oil price decline >$5/bbl on renewed-transit expectation

forecasts.resolution_criteria: Iranian state broadcaster IRIB broadcasts live a speech by Mojtaba Khamenei in his capacity as Supreme Leader, directed at the Iranian public or the nation, before EOD 2026-12-31 (Tehran time). forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Pre-recorded video messages count only if IRIB explicitly designates them 'live' at broadcast time and a TIER1 source confirms.
